  <text x="176" y="406" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Ack (the round button in a row) = "I have seen this alarm". FUXA keeps every alarm in this list until it</text>
  <text x="176" y="426" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">is acknowledged, also one that came and went, so nothing is missed. Ack does not change the PLC.</text>
  <text x="176" y="446" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Reset = the filler PLC (picked in the header) clears its alarm bits, but only those whose</text>
  <text x="176" y="466" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">cause is gone. After a FAULT the machine also needs Start. Colours: red = FAULT, orange = high, yellow = warning.</text>
  <text x="176" y="486" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">The list shows the alarms of every machine (column Machine); Reset acts on the filler only (other machine: picker in the header).</text>
  <text x="16" y="520" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve" font-weight="bold">Alarm history</text>
  <text x="16" y="548" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Menu ☰ (top left) → Alarm history → ⋮ → History Alarms → pick the dates → Apply. It lists every alarm with its on, off and ack time.</text>
  <text x="16" y="572" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">(FUXA's own alarm panel; FUXA 1.3.5 cannot show the history in a table on a view.)</text>
 </g>
</svg>

  <text x="176" y="466" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">cause is gone. After a FAULT the machine also needs Start. Colours: red = FAULT, orange = high, yellow = warning.</text>

 </g>
</svg>

  <text x="176" y="406" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Ack (the round button in a row) = "I have seen this alarm". FUXA keeps every alarm in this list until it</text>

  <text x="176" y="446" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Reset = the labeler PLC (picked in the header) clears its alarm bits, but only those whose</text>
  <text x="176" y="466" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">cause is gone. After a FAULT the machine also needs Start. Colours: red = FAULT, orange = high, yellow = warning.</text>
  <text x="176" y="486" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">The list shows the alarms of every machine (column Machine); Reset acts on the labeler only (other machine: picker in the header).</text>
  <text x="16" y="520" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve" font-weight="bold">Alarm history</text>
  <text x="16" y="548" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Menu ☰ (top left) → Alarm history → ⋮ → History Alarms → pick the dates → Apply. It lists every alarm with its on, off and ack time.</text>
  <text x="16" y="572" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">(FUXA's own alarm panel; FUXA 1.3.5 cannot show the history in a table on a view.)</text>
 </g>
</svg>

  <text x="176" y="406" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Ack (the round button in a row) = "I have seen this alarm". FUXA keeps every alarm in this list until it</text>
  <text x="176" y="426" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">is acknowledged, also one that came and went, so nothing is missed. Ack does not change the PLC.</text>
  <text x="176" y="446" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Reset = the packer PLC (picked in the header) clears its alarm bits, but only those whose</text>
  <text x="176" y="466" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">cause is gone. After a FAULT the machine also needs Start. Colours: red = FAULT, orange = high, yellow = warning.</text>
  <text x="176" y="486" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">The list shows the alarms of every machine (column Machine); Reset acts on the packer only (other machine: picker in the header).</text>
  <text x="16" y="520" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="15" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve" font-weight="bold">Alarm history</text>
  <text x="16" y="548" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="start" fill="#1d1d1d" xml:space="preserve">Menu ☰ (top left) → Alarm history → ⋮ → History Alarms → pick the dates → Apply. It lists every alarm with its on, off and ack time.</text>
  <text x="16" y="572" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="start" fill="#555555" xml:space="preserve">(FUXA's own alarm panel; FUXA 1.3.5 cannot show the history in a table on a view.)</text>
 </g>
</svg>
